title: Generating Synthetic Text Data to Evaluate Causal Inference Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic text datasets with known data-generating processes (using Trivial, LDA, and GPT-2 models) to calculate the causal estimation error of text-based adjustment methods (like Propensity Score Matching, Representation Matching, and Inverse Probability Weighting) when unobserved confounders are present.

Evaluating a measurement error estimator that corrects for the bias of using a noisy text classifier as a proxy for a true unobserved structured variable, utilizing the classifier's estimated error rates.
